status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: no data is on disk in this session and no residual signal has been computed; the public archive is downloaded only after this file is committed and pushed
requested_by: 동동, 2026-10-29: 'test an idea that can start, as a new preregistration' -> market-factor-removed residual signals (ADR 0047 conclusion: coins move on one factor, effective independent names ~3).
question: After removing the common market factor from each coin's daily return, does a residual-return-based cross-sectional long-short sort show a cost-surviving edge in four pre-chosen economically motivated hypotheses, on the top-50 (U50) and top-200 turnover-floor (W200) point-in-time universes?
what_the_author_had_already_seen: ADR 0035/0040/0041/0047 results of the RAW (non-residual) siblings: MOM28, REV7, LOWVOL30, TAKERFLOW, MAX on U50/W200/T150 were all NOT_PROMISING (best S1 SR 0.66 vs null 1.11). No residual-signal result has been seen. Residual signals are correlated with their raw siblings, so the 8 trials are not independent; they are all counted anyway.
scope: DEV only. No validation, locked, paper or IW1 window. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag can only lead to a proposal of a NEW preregistered forward window, which needs the user's explicit go. No preregistration (v2/v3) is activated.

universe.source: as ADR 0047 (every USDT-quoted symbol of the public Binance USDT-M archive including later-delisted ones)
universe.point_in_time_rule: identical to ADR 0047: at each rebalance day i (Monday 00:00 UTC) cut-off = bar i-2; eligible = >=60 daily bars, a bar at the open of day i, 30-day mean daily quote volume v30 >= 2,000,000 USDT; ranked by v30 descending, ties by symbol name.
universe.dropped_from_adr_0047: T150 (tail-only) is not repeated: it was NOT_PROMISING for all raw siblings and is dominated by cost
universe.long_short_size: K = floor(n/5) per side, equal weight 1/(2K), gross 1, net 0 (as ADR 0047)
universe.segment_rule: BTCUSDT is not read in S2 (ADR 0019); every symbol obeys never_read

S1.use: the only segment that decides anything

S2.use: reported, and used only in the fixed S2 > 0.5 condition

never_read: BTC validation/locked TEST + embargo, all symbols

residual_definition.market_factor: m_t = cross-sectional mean of daily close-to-close returns (NaN skipped) of the U50 members eligible at rebalance day i, over the 90 daily returns ending at the cut-off (bar i-2). BTC is not used because BTC is not read in S2. The U50 member set is the one at day i (point in time, uses only data up to the cut-off).
residual_definition.beta: OLS slope of the coin's daily return r on m over the same 90 days with intercept; requires >= 60 valid return days, else the coin has no signal that day.
residual_definition.residual: e_t = r_t - beta * m_t (no intercept subtracted). The same 90-day window is used to estimate beta and to form the signal (standard in the residual-momentum literature, Blitz-Huij-Martens 2011); the beta estimate therefore uses the signal days, stated as a limit.
residual_definition.same_factor_for_both_universes: W200 coins are residualised on the U50 factor as well (one market definition).

hypotheses.economics: residual (idiosyncratic) momentum: continuation of firm-specific news, less crash-prone than total-return momentum (Blitz-Huij-Martens 2011; Gutierrez-Prinsky 2007)
hypotheses.signal: sum of e_t over the last 28 daily returns up to the cut-off divided by the std of e_t over the same 28 days (needs 28 valid days)

hypotheses.economics: residual short-term reversal: liquidity-provision reversal that is stronger once the market move is removed (Blitz-Hanauer-Vidojevic-van Vliet 2013)
hypotheses.signal: sum of e_t over the last 7 daily returns up to the cut-off (needs 7 valid days)

hypotheses.economics: idiosyncratic-volatility anomaly: high residual risk coins are overpriced by lottery demand under limits to arbitrage (Ang-Hodrick-Xing-Zhang 2006)
hypotheses.signal: std of e_t over the last 30 daily returns up to the cut-off (needs 30 valid days)

hypotheses.economics: residual lottery demand: coins with the largest single idiosyncratic jump in the month are overpriced (Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw 2011 applied to residuals)
hypotheses.signal: max of e_t over the last 28 daily returns up to the cut-off (needs 28 valid days)

hypothesis_note: Hold periods and directions are fixed now from the literature, not from any result. Rebalance days: Mondays every hold_days from the first Monday on/after first_entry_from (as ADR 0047). R3 and R4 are expected to overlap with the raw LOWVOL30 and MAX siblings; this is stated in advance. No beta-sorted (BAB) hypothesis is included: it is a beta signal, not a residual one, and needs a beta-neutral weighting that is not in this engine.

trade.entry: open of rebalance day i, signals from bars <= i-2
trade.exit: next rebalance open (full rebalance of the weights to target; cost on the weight change)
trade.missing_data: a held name with no bar earns 0 that day, counted; delisted-while-held counted per side. No filling.

trials.primary: 4 hypotheses x 2 universes (U50, W200) = 8 DEV evaluations, each run once. Recorded as 8 in run/audit/dev_search_trials.jsonl and added to the cumulative count. Any change of window length (90/28/7/30), factor definition, floor, K, hold, signal or cost after this commit is a NEW trial with a new prereg and ADR.

cost.decides: measured/calibrated cost of ADR 0041 (run/audit/lowliq_cost_20261027/calibration_v1.json), unchanged from ADR 0047: per side taker fee 5bp (default tier; maker 2bp is NOT used) + half spread(q15) + impact_coef(q15)*sqrt(10,000 USDT / quote volume of the 23:45 bar), charged on the weight change.

extra_rows.cal_x2: whole calibrated cost doubled (in the flag)
extra_rows.cal_tail_x2: doubled only for names with q15 below 410,000 USDT (in the flag)
extra_rows.cal_limit070: calibrated cost x 0.70 (ADR 0049 limit-order ratio, ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA and unverifiable); reference only, never in the flag

cost.funding: actual settled funding on every held position
cost.participation: share of traded legs with 10,000 / bar quote volume > 0.05 counted and reported; warning only

statistics.unit: daily portfolio return on constant capital 1 (days without a position count as 0)
statistics.report: per universe x hypothesis: S1/S2 annual Sharpe, annual return, max drawdown, t, beta and correlation to the equal-weight universe, beta-adjusted alpha t (vs the equal-weight mean return of the universe held), S1 halves, every cost row, mean turnover, cost paid (% of capital), participation share
statistics.dev_flag_not_a_verdict: DEV_PROMISING only if, under the calibrated cost: (a) S1 annual Sharpe above the expected maximum of 8 unskilled trials over the S1 length (Bailey et al. 2014, engine_lib.expected_max_sr; ~1.0-1.6 range with the cumulative count stated alongside), (b) S1 beta-adjusted alpha t >= 2, (c) both S1 halves positive, (d) S2 annual Sharpe > 0.5, (e) S1 annual Sharpe under cal_x2 > 0, (f) S1 annual Sharpe under cal_tail_x2 > 0. Anything else is NOT_PROMISING. No criterion is relaxed.
statistics.cumulative_trials: also report the cumulative DEV evaluation count (dev_search_trials.jsonl sum + 8) and the expected maximum Sharpe under that count (chance maximum ~1.6-2.4 cited by the requester), and each S1 Sharpe against it; the ADR states it.
statistics.diagnostics_reported_not_flagged: (1) correlation of each residual portfolio's daily return with its raw sibling's is NOT computed (raw siblings are not rerun); instead the market beta of the residual portfolio is reported to show how much market exposure the residualisation removed; (2) the mean cross-sectional rank correlation between each residual signal and the raw sibling signal (R1~H1 total-return 28d, R2~H2 7d, R3~H4 30d total vol, R4~raw 28d max), computed from the same data, to show how different the residual signal really is
statistics.power_note: S1 is about 2.6 years; minimum detectable annual Sharpe at 80% power with 8 Bonferroni tests is ~2.1 (normal approximation). A true effect of Sharpe 1 will most likely be NOT_PROMISING. Accepted and stated in advance.
